_comment: General legal defaults for WHEN enacted state statutes take effect if the text is silent. Applied only to state-level enacted records with effective.kind == 'missing' and a known enactment date. Provenance is tagged 'default_rule'.

statute_effective.source: Cal. Const. art. IV, § 8(c)(1) (regular-session statutes take effect January 1 of the year following enactment)
Mass. Const. amend. art. 48 (laws take effect 90 days after enactment unless an emergency preamble applies)
